name: commerce/assistant-band
title: Shopping Assistant Band
description: A call-out that invites shoppers to ask the store's shopping assistant, with tappable example questions that open the assistant with that question.

ai.useFor: homepage or landing sections that hand the visitor to the shopping assistant with a starting question
ai.avoid: plain calls to action without a question (use CTA Band)

examples.heading: A thoughtful place to start when you are choosing something to keep for years.
examples.body: Tell us how you spend your days, what matters most to you, and who you are shopping for. Explore materials, compare practical details, and find a useful starting point for your next adventure. These questions are invitations to browse at your own pace.
prompts: Which notebook would work well for someone who sketches outdoors, writes every morning, and needs pages that stay flat?
Can you help me choose a practical gift for a friend who enjoys camping, cooking, and spending quiet weekends away?
What is the difference between these materials, and which one needs the least care when I use it every single day?
I have a small apartment and limited storage. Which useful everyday objects would you suggest I take a closer look at?
What should I bring for a weekend trip if I want to pack lightly and make the most of the things I already have?
Help me compare the notebooks for drawing, keeping a travel journal, or planning my week without wasting paper.
Which of these objects would make a good starting point for someone building a small collection of lasting essentials?
Where can I find more information about dimensions, care instructions, and the materials used to make these products?

examples.heading: Good questions. Thoughtful choices.
examples.body: Find something useful for the way you spend your days. Start with a question, and explore the shop together.
prompts: What should I pack for a quiet weekend away?
Help me choose a gift for someone who loves making things.
Which notebook would suit a daily writing habit?
